;Business and economy
*A 1962 [[Ferrari 250 GTO]] is sold for $48.4 million at an auction in [[California]], making it the most expensive car ever sold through auction. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-26/rare-ferrari-250-gto-sells-for-record-48-4-million-at-auction (Bloomberg)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Harbin hotel fire]]
**A hotel fire in [[Harbin]], [[China]], kills 19 people and injures 23 others. The fire broke out at the four-story Beilong Hot Spring Hotel in Harbin's Sun Island recreation area. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-08/25/c_137418591.htm (Xinhua)]
*The collapse of three buildings in [[Mashhad]], [[Iran]], kills ten people and injures nine others. [https://en.mehrnews.com/news/137080/Water-heater-explosion-ruins-3-buildings-kills-10-in-NE-Iran (Mehr News Agency)]
*A bus falls into the [[Iskar Gorge]] near [[Svoge]], [[Bulgaria]], leaving 17 people dead and 17 injured. [http://www.bgnes.com/bylgariia/intsidenti/4605066/ (BGNES)]

;International relations
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**Thirteen sick people are taken off the stranded ''[[Diciotti-class offshore patrol vessel|Diciotti]]'' vessel in [[Catania]], [[Italy]]. [[Albania]] offers to take in 20 migrants. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-italy/doctors-order-16-migrants-off-stranded-italian-boat-as-salvini-defies-u-n-idUSKCN1LA0IF (Reuters)]
**[[Italian Minister of the Interior]] [[Matteo Salvini]] is placed under investigation for possible illegal detention and kidnapping. He subsequently gives permission for the remaining 134 migrants to disembark. [[Ireland]] will take 25 migrants, Albania 20. The [[Conference of Italian Bishops|Italian church]] says it will take in the others. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/25/matteo-salvini-formally-investigated-over-migrant-ship-standoff (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] and [[2008 United States presidential election|2008 presidential]] nominee [[John McCain]] ([[Republican Party (United States)|R]]–[[Arizona|AZ]]) dies at the age of 81. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/08/25/obituaries/john-mccain-dead.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Sport
*[[2018 Challenge Cup]]
**In the [[Rugby League]], the [[Catalans Dragons]] beat the [[Warrington Wolves]] in the 2018 [[List of Challenge Cup finals|Challenge Cup Final]]. It is the first time a team that is not from [[Northern England]] has won the competition. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/rugby-league/45310995 (BBC)]
